title: Transfer of Values to Rate
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

The consumption periods are managed historically. For example, if you change the consumption period Summer, Weekday, 00:00
07:59 to 00:00 08:29, the change date is noted. From this date, the changed period is used for billing.

If you have specified in the Execution of Time-of-Use Interface field that you want to use the time-of-use interface in billing for

profiles whose values are stored in the SAP system, you must use formulas based on formula classes. In this case, the billing
process calls the methods implemented in the formula class.

Transfer of Values to Rate

The result parameter connects the time-of-use interface and the rate. The operands use these parameters to get the values during
billing.

Result parameters can include multiple output parameters. In the example, the result parameter OFFPEAK adds together the
consumption on weekdays to 07:59 and from 18:00, and the entire consumption at weekends, and transferres the total to the
operand CONS OFFPEAK.

The result parameter can also transfer minimum and maximum values to an operand instead of the total. In the example, the result
parameter DEM MAX transfers the maximum demand for weekdays between 08:00 and 17:59.

For more information, seeMap Consumption Times from Time-of-Use Interface in Rate

Customizing Settings

You have to make settings for the time-of-use interface in Customizing for Contract Billing under |Billing Master Data > AMI:
Time-of-Use Interface ». This includes the settings for the time-of-use formula.

Map Consumption Times from Time-of-Use Interface in Rate

Use

The time-of-use interface allows you to flexibly map the consumption behavior of your customers in the rate:

e You can use the same rate to bill consumption and demand that occurs in different periods.

For example: For the meter reading results of meters with registers, you have to define your own rates (on-peak, off-peak)
for the periods.

e You can use the same rate for other customer groups if you only want to change the consumption periods.
